hypotheses.A: Direct robust loss on future price ratios can outperform squared-error regression on both error and final return direction, without fixed convex blend weights.
hypotheses.B: Feature-dependent class magnitude experts combined with the existing causal classifier can outperform pooled class shapes; compare MAE-optimal and MAPE-optimal point decisions.

features: Exactly research_joint_indicator.matrix: prior OOS forecast ratios/raw direction scores, contemporaneous market regime and input count. No new raw-price, sector-relative or drawdown features are available in this snapshot.
regressorLoss: absolute_error for candidates, squared_error for direct_squared control; target is future-price/current-price ratio, not log return
returnLossWeights: Equal total weight per origin date; no class quota or inverse-frequency rebalancing.
mapeLossWeights: Date-equal weights divided by realized target ratio, rescaled to mean one; weighted absolute error equals MAPE objective up to a positive constant.
magnitudeTraining: All previous source OOS outcome rows with origin < new origin AND targetDate < new origin. Direct and class-specific regressors use identical available mature labels. Class-specific experts use their own class only and date weights within class.
classifier: Reuse unchanged joint_logistic trained on purged fit and latest two mature calibration dates, per joint protocol. Isolates magnitude and decision-loss changes, not a new direction detector.
conditionalModel: Three feature-dependent representative price ratios, one per down/flat/up class; clipped to that class historical support. This is a three-atom approximation, not a full calibrated conditional distribution.
conditionalPoint: Weighted median of class support atoms; weights p(class) for return MAE, p(class)/atom for price MAPE. Do not use argmax class to overwrite forecast sign.
supportBounds: Clip numeric outputs to min/max of previously matured training support; class experts use only their class support. Record clipping counts. No holdout-derived bounds.
fallback: If any class has fewer than 50 mature rows, retain full evaluation date using pooled class loss-optimal medians for conditional experts; report fallback.
evaluationSplit: Same fixed last half of origin dates as joint v1 and blend v1; same issuer/date paired rows; previously inspected exploratory data.
directionRule: Final numeric ratio above 1.02 is up, below 0.98 is down, otherwise neutral. Reference classifier argmax reported separately.
probabilityRule: No new probability-performance claim for numeric candidate outputs; report unchanged reference Brier and reliability separately.
additionalErrorGate: Return MAE at least 2% better than both noChange and priceOnly; p90 return error no worse; also retain blend v1 historical gates.
diagnostics: paired date error/direction difference bootstrap, exploratory only
within-class magnitude error with future true class used ONLY for a non-executable diagnostic
selection: none; keep all declared candidates, squared control, and fallback dates
warning: Research design hypotheses, not best parameters or validated trading returns. This experiment uses existing OOS forecasts as meta features; it is not a production-model comparison.
